title.zh: 讨好型人格测试

resultHeading.zh: 你的三部分讨好倾向自评

seoTitle.zh: 讨好型人格测试：10题PPS、三维结果与完整解读
seoTitle.en: People Pleaser Test: 10 PPS Items, Three Scores and Full Guides

description.zh: 通过10条PPS自评，分别了解搁置自身需要、照顾他人的责任感与迎合期望。约4分钟，免费查看三项均分、有效题数和完整解读；无需注册，保留量表来源与中文改编说明。
description.en: Explore own needs, felt responsibility and others’ expectations with 10 PPS items. Free means, rated-item counts and full guides in about four minutes, no signup.

introduction.zh: “讨好型人格”是常见搜索名称，本页讨论的是日常自报的讨好倾向，不把它当作人格障碍诊断。通过10条PPS陈述，你可以分别回看是否容易搁置自身需要、怎样感受照顾他人的责任，以及多大程度迎合他人的期望。三部分独立呈现，帮助把“我是不是太讨好”转成更具体的观察：这次答应是否出于自愿，自己的需要是否被听见，以及职责与余量是否说清楚。题本保留作者英文与费马中文工作译文，来源、许可及网站改编在下方说明；全部三份完整指南可在作答前阅读。
introduction.en: This People Pleaser Test explores an everyday self-reported tendency, rather than diagnosing a personality disorder. Ten PPS statements help you separately reflect on setting aside your own needs, felt responsibility for others and orientation to their expectations. The three parts turn a broad question about people pleasing into more specific observations: whether you freely chose an agreement, whether your needs were heard and whether duties and capacity were clear. Author-provided English and FermatMind’s working Chinese translation are retained, with sources, licence and website adaptations explained below. All three full guides can be read before answering.

instructions.zh: 按每句话对你一般情况的符合程度作答：1完全不符合、2有一点符合、3有些符合、4大体符合、5完全符合；本版不规定固定月数。尽量结合实际经历，不按希望成为的样子作答，也不替别人打分。无法判断或不愿回答可选NA。全部10条先完成选择；自身需要4题中至少3题有效，责任感与他人期望各3题全部有效时才显示相应均分。NA、中文译文、中间选项标签及显示规则属于网站改编。
instructions.en: Rate how well each statement applies to you generally: 1 Does not apply at all, 2 Applies a little, 3 Applies somewhat, 4 Applies mostly, 5 Completely applies. This form specifies no fixed-month recall period. Use actual experiences rather than an ideal self, and answer only for yourself. Choose NA if unsure or unwilling. Complete all ten selections; own needs requires three of four numeric ratings, while responsibility and expectations each require all three. NA, Chinese translation, intermediate option labels and display rules are website adaptations.

label.en: Unsure or prefer not to answer

title.zh: 搁置自身需要

headline.zh: 让自己的需要也进入安排
headline.en: Include your own needs in the arrangement

summary.zh: 这一部分问是否忘记、难以表达或为了帮助别人搁置自身需要。它不把一次让步或自愿照顾归成固定人格。
summary.en: This part asks about forgetting, struggling to voice or setting aside your own needs, without turning a compromise or voluntary care into a fixed identity.

title.zh: 讨好倾向结果：自身需要、表达与具体例子
title.en: People Pleasing and Your Own Needs: Full PPS Guide

description.zh: 阅读PPS自身需要部分的完整解释，比较忘记、难以表达和为了帮助而搁置需要，附具体对话、反例和小观察。均分或资料不足都保留，不作人格等级、诊断或关系判定。
description.en: Read the PPS own-needs guide with higher and lower readings, original dialogue, counterexamples and a small observation. Full free meaning without personality tiers or diagnosis.

scoreReading.zh: 全部10条先选择1完全不符合至5完全符合，无法判断或不愿回答可选NA。三部分分别取一位小数均分：自身需要4条至少3条有效，责任感与他人期望各3条都有效；不足则不出个人均分，NA不补零。NA、中间标签、最低条数、取整与解释为本站改编，不是研究中的缺失规则、心理阈值或常模。三个连续读法不合成总分、不按最高值派型，不使用四分位等级；小数差异不证明因果或统计显著。
scoreReading.en: Select an answer for all ten items, from 1 Does not apply at all to 5 Completely applies, or NA if unsure or unwilling to answer. Each part has a one-decimal mean: own needs requires three of four ratings, responsibility and expectations all three each. Otherwise there is no personal mean; NA is not zero-filled. NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts, rounding and interpretations are website adaptations, not a study missing-data rule, psychological cutoff or norm. Three continuous readings produce no total, highest-score type or quartile tiers; decimal differences establish neither causation nor statistical significance.

title.zh: 这部分在观察什么

paragraphs.zh: 四条PPS题目涉及忘记自己的需要、难以为需要发声、自己状态不好时仍优先帮助别人，以及为了帮助而忽略需要。它们由本人判断符合程度，不要求你证明谁付出更多。均分只概括这些条目的本次回答；具体是什么需要、当时能否选择、是否有实际责任，仍要看真实情境。
paragraphs.en: Four PPS items concern forgetting your needs, difficulty standing up for them, helping others rather than yourself when unwell, and neglecting needs to help. You rate how well the statements apply, rather than proving who gives more. A mean summarises those responses on this occasion. Which need was involved, whether a choice was available and what responsibilities existed still require the actual context.

title.zh: 较高、较低与混合回答

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你对这些描述较认同，值得回看哪一条更贴近实际；它不证明持续受伤、关系有害或已经耗竭。较低均分也不证明自私、冷漠或边界一定稳固。四条差异可能很有用，例如你记得自己的需要，却在表达上犹豫；不要让一个均分抹掉这个区别。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean means greater agreement with these statements and invites a look at which one fits. It does not prove continuing harm, an unsafe relationship or exhaustion. A lower mean establishes neither selfishness nor permanently secure boundaries. Differences can matter: you may remember a need but hesitate to express it. Keep that distinction instead of allowing one average to erase it.

title.zh: 一个可直接使用的对话

paragraphs.zh: 普通、可安全讨论的场景里，别人请你当天加做一件事，你发现这会挤掉已有安排。可以说：“我今天只能处理已经答应的部分，新增内容要另约时间。”这句话说清当前范围，不要求解释全部私人原因，也不保证对方会满意。它是本站独立编写的例子，不是临床处方或适用于所有关系的固定话术。
paragraphs.en: In an ordinary situation where discussion is safe, someone asks for an extra task today and you notice it would displace an existing commitment. You could say, “I can finish what I already agreed to today; we would need another time for the extra part.” This names the present scope without requiring private explanations or guaranteeing satisfaction. It is an original example, not a prescription for every relationship.

title.zh: 反例：愿意帮助也成立

paragraphs.zh: 你知道自己的安排，愿意这次调整，并能在必要时重新商量，不能仅因帮助别人就判成讨好。相反，即使嘴上已经答应，也可以观察是否忽略了重要需要。一次选择、照顾责任与长期模式不是同一件事；测试没有收集完整责任背景，不负责给你或别人判定谁更善良、更应该让步。
paragraphs.en: Knowing your plans, freely choosing an adjustment and being able to discuss it again is not automatically people pleasing simply because it helps someone. An agreement can still merit reflection if an important need was overlooked. A single choice, a caring responsibility and a continuing pattern are different things. The test lacks that full background and cannot judge who is kinder or ought to give way.

title.zh: 与另外两部分比较

paragraphs.zh: 你可能并不强烈觉得要照顾所有人，却在具体请求中忘记自己；也可能责任感很强，但仍会给自己的安排留位置。他人期望部分另问迎合和拒绝困难，不能由这部分均分自动补出。三项都保留，不挑一个最强驱动，更不把它们相加后派成四种健康等级或猜测伴侣性格。
paragraphs.en: You may feel little general obligation to care for everyone yet overlook yourself during a request, or feel strongly responsible while still making room for your plans. The expectations part separately asks about pleasing and difficulty refusing. Its result cannot be filled in from this mean. Keep all three without choosing a strongest driver, adding them into four health tiers or assigning a partner’s personality.

title.zh: 情境和限制同样重要

paragraphs.zh: 有些责任不能立即取消，有些关系里直接拒绝并不容易或不安全。测试不把无法马上改变解释为软弱，也不要求用对抗证明成长。可以先区分已经承担的职责、可以协商的部分和当前没有选择的限制。这里没有从分数推出童年、依恋、创伤、抑郁或焦虑原因；需要这些信息时应另看实际经历。
paragraphs.en: Some responsibilities cannot be cancelled immediately, and direct refusal may be difficult or unsafe in some relationships. The test does not interpret inability to change at once as weakness or demand confrontation as proof of growth. Distinguish existing duties, negotiable parts and present constraints. A score establishes no childhood, attachment, trauma, depression or anxiety explanation; those questions require their own information.

title.zh: 一个小而可选的观察

paragraphs.zh: 在一次普通请求后，私下写下三件事：对方希望什么、自己原本需要什么、最后实际答应了什么。先观察而不急着补偿或推翻安排，只挑可安全协商的一小处尝试说明。记录不需要上传、发给对方或证明改变；如果不想练习，也可以只保留这份解释，下次再决定。
paragraphs.en: After an ordinary request, privately note what was asked, what you originally needed and what you actually agreed to. Observe before rushing to compensate or reverse an arrangement. If appropriate and safe, choose one small negotiable detail to explain. The note requires no upload, disclosure to the other person or proof of change. You can also keep the guide and decide later whether to try anything.

title.zh: 这一均分怎样产生

paragraphs.zh: 本部分4条，至少3条有效1—5评分才取一位小数均分，NA排除而不补零；其他两部分各3条都要有效。全部10条先完成选择。允许本部分缺1条、加入NA和四舍五入是本站展示改编，不是原研究验证的缺失处理或心理阈值。资料不足时不生成个人均分，完整说明仍呈现，也不按低中高划线。
paragraphs.en: This four-item part needs at least three valid 1–5 ratings for a one-decimal mean; NA is excluded rather than zero-filled. The other two parts each need all three ratings, after all ten selections are made. Allowing one missing item here, adding NA and rounding are website adaptations, not a validated missing-data protocol or psychological cutoff. Insufficient information produces no personal mean while retaining the full guide, without low, medium or high bands.

title.zh: 条目署名、许可与改编范围

paragraphs.zh: 条目来源：Christian Blötner（2026），Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples，DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2；原文及最终10条Table1：https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2 。按CC BY 4.0使用：https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ 。保留作者提供的英文条目，中文由费马独立翻译；加入NA、中间标签、最低条数、一位小数均分与原创解释，均已标明改动。原研究只施测德文，不表示英中文已验证、作者背书或本站有常模。
paragraphs.en: Items: Christian Blötner (2026), Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples, DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2; article and final Table 1: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2 . Used under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Author-provided English wording is retained; FermatMind independently translated Chinese and added NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts, one-decimal means and original explanations. These changes are identified. The studies administered German only; they establish neither English–Chinese validation, author endorsement nor website norms.

title.zh: 照顾他人的责任感

headline.zh: 区分关心、实际职责与包揽感
headline.en: Separate caring, actual duties and felt responsibility

summary.zh: 这一部分问对他人福祉的责任感与照顾愿望。高认同本身不等于不健康，也不证明你要负责每个人的情绪。
summary.en: This part asks about responsibility for others’ well-being and the wish to care. Strong agreement alone is not unhealthy or an obligation to manage everyone’s feelings.

title.zh: 讨好倾向结果：照顾责任、关心与帮助范围
title.en: People Pleasing Responsibility: Caring and Full PPS Guide

description.zh: 阅读PPS责任感部分完整结果，区分照顾愿望、实际职责与包揽感，附具体对话、反例和小清单。高认同不自动等于不健康，也不说明你负责每个人的情绪。
description.en: Explore PPS responsibility with caring wishes, actual duties, original dialogue and counterexamples. Full free guide without assuming that strong care is unhealthy.

scoreReading.zh: 全部10条先选择1完全不符合至5完全符合，无法判断或不愿回答可选NA。三部分分别取一位小数均分：自身需要4条至少3条有效，责任感与他人期望各3条都有效；不足则不出个人均分，NA不补零。NA、中间标签、最低条数、取整与解释为本站改编，不是研究中的缺失规则、心理阈值或常模。三个连续读法不合成总分、不按最高值派型，不使用四分位等级；小数差异不证明因果或统计显著。
scoreReading.en: Select an answer for all ten items, from 1 Does not apply at all to 5 Completely applies, or NA if unsure or unwilling to answer. Each part has a one-decimal mean: own needs requires three of four ratings, responsibility and expectations all three each. Otherwise there is no personal mean; NA is not zero-filled. NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts, rounding and interpretations are website adaptations, not a study missing-data rule, psychological cutoff or norm. Three continuous readings produce no total, highest-score type or quartile tiers; decimal differences establish neither causation nor statistical significance.

title.zh: 这部分在观察什么

paragraphs.zh: 三条PPS题目分别问是否觉得有责任让别人过得好、对他人福祉负有责任，以及照顾他人的愿望。它们没有完整询问你的实际照顾职责、对方需要或你已做过什么，因此不能把认同直接换成过度负责、控制或情绪劳动。关心的意愿与是否牺牲自身需要，应分别对照其他部分和真实情境。
paragraphs.en: Three PPS items ask about feeling responsible that others are well, obligation toward their well-being and a strong desire to care. They do not fully ask about actual caring duties, what another person needs or what you have done. Agreement therefore cannot be converted straight into excessive responsibility, control or emotional labour. Read the wish to care separately from self-sacrifice, alongside the other parts and actual context.

title.zh: 较高与较低都不能判好坏
title.en: Neither higher nor lower ranks character

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示更认同这些责任与愿望描述，不自动说明不健康、失去自己或承担不起。较低也不证明没有同理心、没有爱或拒绝履行责任。你可能认真完成具体职责，却不认为自己负责所有人的福祉；也可能很想照顾人，但实际付出有明确范围。均分没有能力或道德排名功能。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean shows stronger agreement with the responsibility and caring statements, not automatic ill health, loss of self or inability to cope. A lower mean proves neither lack of empathy nor refusal of real duties. You may fulfil a specific duty carefully without feeling responsible for everyone’s well-being, or wish strongly to care while limiting what you actually do. The mean ranks neither ability nor morality.

title.zh: 把帮助范围说具体

paragraphs.zh: 在可安全沟通的普通情境中，朋友希望你陪着处理一件事，你可以说：“我今晚能陪你聊二十分钟，后面的决定还是由你来做。”这同时说明可提供的支持与决定归属，不把对方情绪当成你的考试。实际时长和职责要按情境调整，不能用这句话免除已经承担的照顾责任，也不保证对方接受。
paragraphs.en: In an ordinary situation where discussion is safe, a friend wants support with a decision. You could say, “I can talk it through for twenty minutes tonight; the decision will still be yours.” This names support and decision ownership without making another person’s feelings your examination. Adjust the time and duties to the situation; the example cancels no existing care obligation and guarantees no agreement.

title.zh: 反例：有责任不等于包揽

paragraphs.zh: 照顾孩子、履行岗位职责或完成已经商定的支持，本来可能包含明确责任。不能因为责任感高，就把这些承诺称作讨好；同样，也不需要为了降低分数而突然停止必要照顾。反例的作用是提醒你看清具体范围：哪些是应做的，哪些可协商，哪些结果不由一个人控制，测试不能替代这个判断。
paragraphs.en: Caring for a child, meeting a role’s requirements or providing agreed support can involve real responsibilities. Strong responsibility does not make those commitments people pleasing, and lowering a test score is no reason to stop necessary care abruptly. The counterexample asks for a concrete scope: what is required, what is negotiable and which outcomes one person cannot control. The questionnaire cannot make that judgment for you.

title.zh: 与自身需要和期望比较

paragraphs.zh: 责任感高但自身需要部分低，可能是这次回答认可照顾，同时较少认可忽视自己；不要把它合成一种健康类型。若他人期望也较高，可以分别回看是愿意照顾、难以拒绝，还是具体职责在起作用。三部分的题数和措辞不同，均分的小差异不证明哪个机制在因果上驱动了另一个。
paragraphs.en: Higher responsibility with lower agreement about neglecting needs can reflect caring alongside less reported self-neglect in these answers; it does not create a healthy type. If expectations are also higher, separately consider willingness, difficulty refusing and actual duties. Item counts and wording differ between parts. Small mean differences do not establish which mechanism causes or drives another.

title.zh: 不能从分数读出他人的状态
title.en: Other people’s states are not measured

paragraphs.zh: 这里所有回答来自你自己，没有记录别人是否需要帮助、是否故意施压或是否满意。不能由这个均分诊断伴侣、家人或同事，也不能预测关系能否维持。别人的反应可能与你的行动有关，也可能涉及许多其他因素；测试不把结果归咎于你，更不要求让所有人情绪良好才算关心。
paragraphs.en: All responses come from you. They record neither whether someone needs help, deliberately applies pressure nor feels satisfied. The mean cannot diagnose a partner, relative or colleague or predict a relationship’s future. Someone’s reaction may involve your actions and many other factors. The test assigns no blame and does not require everyone to feel well before your care counts as care.

title.zh: 一次范围清单

paragraphs.zh: 挑一件普通、可讨论的照顾事项，写三栏：我明确答应的、需要和对方再确认的、我无法保证的。比如可答应在某时回电，但不能保证一次谈话解决全部问题。只选一个需要确认的细节沟通，不把整段关系当成实验。记录可以完全私下保留，也不要求马上练习拒绝或做重大决定。
paragraphs.en: Choose an ordinary caring task that can be discussed and make three private columns: what I agreed to, what needs clarification, and what I cannot guarantee. You might agree to call at a time without guaranteeing that one conversation resolves everything. Clarify one detail rather than experimenting on a whole relationship. Keep the note private if you wish; no immediate refusal or major decision is required.

title.zh: 三条均分与资料不足

paragraphs.zh: 本部分3条都需要有效1—5评分，才取一位小数均分；任一NA就明确资料不足，不补中性、零分或猜测。全部10条先完成选择，另外两部分独立处理。新增NA、最低条数和显示均分属于本站改编，不是研究中的诊断阈值、四分位或官方缺失规则。即使本部分不足，也保留全部解释与重测。
paragraphs.en: All three items in this part need valid 1–5 ratings for a one-decimal mean. Any NA produces insufficient information without neutrality, zero-filling or guessing. Complete all ten selections first; the other parts are handled separately. Added NA, minimum counts and displayed means are website adaptations, not diagnostic cutoffs, quartiles or an official missing-data rule. The guide and retake remain available even when this part is insufficient.

title.zh: 条目署名、许可与改编范围

paragraphs.zh: 条目来源：Christian Blötner（2026），Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples，DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2；原文及最终10条Table1：https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2 。按CC BY 4.0使用：https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ 。保留作者提供的英文条目，中文由费马独立翻译；加入NA、中间标签、最低条数、一位小数均分与原创解释，均已标明改动。原研究只施测德文，不表示英中文已验证、作者背书或本站有常模。
paragraphs.en: Items: Christian Blötner (2026), Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples, DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2; article and final Table 1: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2 . Used under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Author-provided English wording is retained; FermatMind independently translated Chinese and added NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts, one-decimal means and original explanations. These changes are identified. The studies administered German only; they establish neither English–Chinese validation, author endorsement nor website norms.

title.zh: 迎合他人的期望

headline.zh: 把愿意、期待和拒绝困难分开看
headline.en: Separate willingness, expectations and difficulty refusing

summary.zh: 这一部分问满足期待、取悦冲动和拒绝请求的困难，不从一次答应或拒绝给人判型。
summary.en: This part asks about meeting expectations, the urge to please and difficulty refusing, without typing anyone from an agreement or refusal.

title.zh: 讨好倾向结果：他人期望、拒绝困难与对话
title.en: People Pleasing Expectations: Requests and Full PPS Guide

description.zh: 阅读PPS他人期望部分完整解释，区分满足期待、取悦冲动和拒绝困难，含具体对话、合作反例与小观察。不按一次答应或拒绝判型，不诊断伴侣或预测关系。
description.en: Read the PPS expectations guide to meeting expectations, pleasing and difficulty refusing. Full free dialogue and counterexamples without typing partners or predicting relationships.

scoreReading.zh: 全部10条先选择1完全不符合至5完全符合，无法判断或不愿回答可选NA。三部分分别取一位小数均分：自身需要4条至少3条有效，责任感与他人期望各3条都有效；不足则不出个人均分，NA不补零。NA、中间标签、最低条数、取整与解释为本站改编，不是研究中的缺失规则、心理阈值或常模。三个连续读法不合成总分、不按最高值派型，不使用四分位等级；小数差异不证明因果或统计显著。
scoreReading.en: Select an answer for all ten items, from 1 Does not apply at all to 5 Completely applies, or NA if unsure or unwilling to answer. Each part has a one-decimal mean: own needs requires three of four ratings, responsibility and expectations all three each. Otherwise there is no personal mean; NA is not zero-filled. NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts, rounding and interpretations are website adaptations, not a study missing-data rule, psychological cutoff or norm. Three continuous readings produce no total, highest-score type or quartile tiers; decimal differences establish neither causation nor statistical significance.

title.zh: 这部分在观察什么

paragraphs.zh: 三条PPS题目问你是否努力满足别人的期望、有强烈取悦冲动，以及难以拒绝请求。它们描述你自己的认同，不检验对方实际上期待什么，也不说明所有答应都出于害怕。工作要求、协商后的承诺、自愿帮助和不想却难说不，都可能需要分别理解；均分不替你判定动机或给别人定性。
paragraphs.en: Three PPS items ask about trying to meet others’ expectations, a strong urge to please and difficulty refusing requests. They record your agreement, not what someone actually expects or whether every yes comes from fear. Work requirements, negotiated commitments, voluntary help and an unwanted yes can need different readings. The mean cannot decide your motives or assign a character judgment to somebody else.

title.zh: 较高、较低与条目差异

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你较认同这些描述，可以回看究竟是期待、取悦还是拒绝困难更贴近本次体验。较低不表示总能拒绝，也不代表你不愿合作。某个人可能努力兑现合理期待，却对不适当请求说得出不；另一个人可能不在意多数评价，却在某段关系里难以拒绝。三条不能完整描述所有情境。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean means greater agreement and invites a look at whether expectations, pleasing or refusal difficulty fits your experience. A lower mean does not mean always being able to refuse or being unwilling to cooperate. Someone may meet reasonable expectations while declining an unsuitable request; another may disregard most opinions yet struggle in one relationship. Three items cannot describe every context.

title.zh: 先留出决定时间

paragraphs.zh: 在可安全讨论的普通邀请里，如果你还没确认安排，可以说：“我现在还不能答应，晚点确认后再回复你。”这表示尚未决定，不是绕着说已经答应，也不需要立刻找一个补偿方案。请按实际能做到的时间回复，不用承诺做不到的事；这个独立例子不保证对方不失望或不会继续请求。
paragraphs.en: For an ordinary invitation where discussion is safe, you might say, “I cannot commit yet; I will check my plans and reply later.” This leaves a decision open instead of making an indirect yes, and requires no immediate compensating offer. Reply within a timeframe you can actually manage. This original example does not guarantee that the other person will feel pleased or stop asking.

title.zh: 反例：合作不是自动讨好
title.en: Counterexample: cooperation is not automatically pleasing

paragraphs.zh: 按已商定的分工完成事情、愿意接受轮流选择，或在有余力时帮助人，都不能仅凭形式被归为讨好。观察的是你自己是否愿意、付出代价与是否有可协商空间，不能只数说了几次“好”。同样，一次直接拒绝也不证明讨好倾向已经消失，结果不是看某句台词是否足够强硬。
paragraphs.en: Completing agreed work, accepting a turn-taking choice or helping when you have capacity is not automatically people pleasing. Consider willingness, costs and room for discussion rather than simply counting yeses. One direct refusal likewise does not prove that a tendency has disappeared. This result is not based on whether a particular sentence sounds sufficiently forceful or whether cooperation looks accommodating from outside.

title.zh: 与需要和责任感的组合
title.en: Read it alongside needs and responsibility

paragraphs.zh: 他人期望较高、自身需要较低，可以只是本次回答认可满足期待，同时较少认可忽视需要；不能直接命名为某种平衡人格。责任感另问照顾愿望和福祉义务，不能由难拒绝自动推出。三个连续均分可分别看，也可保持资料不足；最高值不等于核心原因，低分也不证明关系健康或安全。
paragraphs.en: Higher expectations with lower agreement about neglecting needs can describe these answers without creating a balanced personality type. Responsibility separately asks about caring wishes and obligation for well-being; difficulty refusing cannot supply its result. Read three continuous means or retain insufficient states. The highest value is not necessarily a root cause, and a lower score does not establish a healthy or safe relationship.

title.zh: 现实限制与他人的反应

paragraphs.zh: 有些场景有权力差、职责或后果，直接拒绝未必容易。你不需要用这份测试证明某人有操控意图，也不必立刻对抗或结束关系来符合某种建议。能否协商和怎样做需要实际信息；对方不高兴也不自动说明你做错。这里不由分数推断依恋、童年、创伤、心理障碍或分手概率。
paragraphs.en: Some situations involve power differences, duties or consequences, making direct refusal difficult. You need not use this test to prove manipulation or immediately confront someone or end a relationship to follow advice. Whether and how discussion is possible needs real information. Another person’s disappointment does not automatically mean you acted wrongly. The mean establishes no attachment, childhood, trauma, disorder or breakup probability.

title.zh: 区分期待和明确请求

paragraphs.zh: 选择一件低风险小事，写下“对方明确说了什么”和“我猜对方希望什么”。如果合适，可只澄清一个细节，例如需要你何时回复或愿意接受什么范围，而不是猜测全部想法。记录不用发给任何人，改变也不要求立刻成功；如果只是合理承诺，就可以按原计划做，不必为了测试刻意拒绝。
paragraphs.en: For one low-stakes situation, note what was explicitly requested and what you guessed was expected. If appropriate, clarify one detail, such as when a reply is needed or what scope is acceptable, instead of guessing everything. The note needs no disclosure and the exercise no immediate success. If it is a reasonable commitment, keep the plan; there is no reason to manufacture a refusal for the test.

title.zh: 计分与资料不足

paragraphs.zh: 本部分3条都要有效1—5评分，才显示一位小数均分，任一NA则资料不足。全部10条先选择，不用其他部分替你估算，也不补零。本站加入NA、中间标签、最低条数与均分读法，未验证其英中文等价或缺失规则；没有四分位、常模百分位或人格等级。结果不足仍能阅读三份完整说明、重测或结束。
paragraphs.en: All three items need valid 1–5 ratings for a one-decimal mean; any NA leaves insufficient information. Complete all ten selections first, without estimation from another part or zero-filling. The website adds NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts and mean readings without validating English–Chinese equivalence or a missing-data protocol. There are no quartiles, norm percentiles or personality tiers. An insufficient result still provides all three full guides, retake and a choice to stop.

title.zh: 条目署名、许可与改编范围

paragraphs.zh: 条目来源：Christian Blötner（2026），Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples，DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2；原文及最终10条Table1：https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2 。按CC BY 4.0使用：https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ 。保留作者提供的英文条目，中文由费马独立翻译；加入NA、中间标签、最低条数、一位小数均分与原创解释，均已标明改动。原研究只施测德文，不表示英中文已验证、作者背书或本站有常模。
paragraphs.en: Items: Christian Blötner (2026), Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples, DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2; article and final Table 1: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2 . Used under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Author-provided English wording is retained; FermatMind independently translated Chinese and added NA, intermediate labels, minimum counts, one-decimal means and original explanations. These changes are identified. The studies administered German only; they establish neither English–Chinese validation, author endorsement nor website norms.

title.zh: Christian Blötner（2026）：PPS原研究、条目与署名来源
title.en: Christian Blötner (2026): PPS study and attribution source

title.zh: PPS最终10条英德原文：出版方Table1
title.en: Final ten PPS English and German items: publisher Table 1

title.zh: CC BY 4.0许可：署名、提供许可链接并标明改动

title.zh: Cleveland Clinic：日常讨好与选择的背景说明
Cleveland Clinic：需要与边界沟通的背景说明
title.en: Cleveland Clinic: needs and boundary communication background

title.zh: 10题PPS怎样计分？三部分分别求均分
title.en: How are the ten PPS items scored? Three separate means

paragraphs.zh: 本版10条均为正向计分，没有反向题。五个符合程度选项依次编码为1—5；每部分原始和S等于有效评分之和，n为有效条数，显示均分为S÷n并保留一位小数。三部分题数为4、3、3，不直接比较原始和，也不把所有条目合成一个本站总分。
paragraphs.en: All ten items in this form are scored in the same direction, without reverse scoring. The five applicability categories are coded 1–5. Within each part, S is the sum of numeric ratings and n their count; the display is S divided by n, rounded to one decimal. Parts contain four, three and three items, so raw sums are not directly compared or combined into a website total.

paragraphs.zh: 例如自身需要四题为2、4、5、NA，有效原始和11、有效题数3，均分为11÷3≈3.7。责任感三题为2、4、5，也为3.7；但2、4、NA只有两条有效，显示资料不足。NA不补成零或3分。每部分至少三条有效是本站显示完整度规则，不是经过验证的心理阈值或原研究缺失处理方案。
paragraphs.en: For own-needs ratings of 2, 4, 5 and NA, the numeric sum is 11 across three ratings, giving 11/3≈3.7. Responsibility ratings of 2, 4 and 5 also give 3.7, but 2, 4 and NA leave only two ratings and are insufficient. NA is not zero-filled or assigned 3. Requiring three ratings per part is a website display-completeness rule, not a validated psychological cutoff or the study’s missing-data procedure.

title.zh: 均分、混合回答与资料不足怎样理解？
title.en: How should means, mixed responses and insufficient information be read?

paragraphs.zh: 均分较高表示更认同这一部分的陈述，较低表示较少认同；先回看条目和有效题数。相同均分可以来自不同组合，例如2、4、5与3、3、5都约为3.7；它们未必描述同样的经历。1—5是有序选项的编码，求均分是本版摘要约定，没有因此证明每一步心理距离相等。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of that part’s statements and a lower mean less endorsement. Review items and rated-item counts first. Ratings of 2, 4, 5 and 3, 3, 5 both average about 3.7 but need not describe the same experiences. Coding ordered categories as 1–5 and averaging them is this form’s summary convention, not proof of equal psychological distances.

paragraphs.zh: 三个均分不是互斥的人格类型，也不按最高值找“核心驱动”。结果没有四分位等级、人群百分位、匹配概率或善良分数；小数差异没有统计显著含义。资料不足只表示未生成个人均分，全部三份完整解释仍显示。不能由较低认同推断自私，也不能由较高认同断定关系有问题。
paragraphs.en: The three means are not exclusive personality types or a way to select a strongest driver. There are no quartile tiers, population percentiles, match probabilities or kindness scores; decimal differences establish no statistical significance. Insufficient information means no personal mean, while all three full guides remain visible. Lower endorsement does not establish selfishness, and higher endorsement does not establish a troubled relationship.

title.zh: 讨好倾向与宜人性、依恋、沟通方式的区别
title.en: People pleasing, agreeableness, attachment and communication

paragraphs.zh: PPS本版关注自身需要、照顾责任和他人期望。宜人性是较宽的人格特质主题，依恋讨论亲近关系中的取向，沟通自评则可能关注表达行为；这些主题有交集，但名称相近不代表量表相同。不能用三项PPS均分换算MBTI、大五人格、依恋类型或沟通能力。
paragraphs.en: This PPS form concerns own needs, felt responsibility and others’ expectations. Agreeableness is a broader trait topic, attachment concerns orientations in close relationships, and communication reflections may concern expression. Overlap does not make these measures interchangeable. Three PPS means cannot be converted into MBTI, Big Five traits, attachment types or communication ability.

paragraphs.zh: 同样说“可以”，可能是自愿帮助、履行约定、权衡现实限制，也可能是难以拒绝。一次可见行为不足以判断动机。本测试没有测出童年经历、创伤反应、焦虑抑郁、伴侣人格或职业适配；这些问题需要各自适当的信息与评估，不能由讨好标签代答。
paragraphs.en: The same agreement can reflect freely chosen help, an existing duty, practical constraints or difficulty refusing. One visible action does not establish its motive. This test does not reveal childhood history, trauma responses, anxiety, depression, a partner’s personality or career fit. Those questions need their own information and appropriate assessment rather than an answer supplied by a people-pleaser label.

title.zh: 三部分分别在问什么？
title.en: What do the three parts ask about?

paragraphs.zh: 搁置自身需要：四条陈述涉及忘记需要、难以为需要发声，以及帮助别人时忽视自己。重点是“自己的需要有没有被纳入”，而不是是否经常帮助别人。可以观察休息、时间、任务安排或表达偏好中，自己是否有机会提出具体需要。
paragraphs.en: Setting aside own needs: four statements concern forgetting needs, difficulty voicing them and neglecting yourself while helping. The question is whether your needs are included, rather than how often you help. Consider whether you have opportunities to name needs about rest, time, tasks or preferences.

paragraphs.zh: 照顾他人的责任感：三条陈述涉及他人是否过得好、福祉责任与照顾愿望。题目本身不区分所有合理职责与额外负担，因此较高认同不自动等于过度负责。照顾孩子、履行工作约定或自愿支持朋友，都需要结合具体职责、资源与分工理解。
paragraphs.en: Felt responsibility for others: three statements concern others being well, responsibility for well-being and the wish to care. The items do not distinguish every legitimate duty from extra burden, so high endorsement does not automatically establish excessive responsibility. Childcare, work agreements and voluntary support require consideration of duties, resources and shared roles.

paragraphs.zh: 迎合他人的期望：三条陈述涉及满足期待、取悦冲动与拒绝请求的困难。可以分别看“我知道对方真正要求什么吗”“我是否先核对自己的余量”“不答应时是否有表达空间”，不把一次答应或一次拒绝变成固定身份。
paragraphs.en: Orientation to others’ expectations: three statements concern meeting expectations, an urge to please and difficulty refusing. Ask separately whether you know what is actually requested, have checked your capacity and have room to express a different response. One agreement or refusal does not determine a fixed identity.

title.zh: PPS研究证据与本网站版本
title.en: PPS research evidence and this website edition

paragraphs.zh: Blötner（2026）在两组德国样本中开发和检验PPS，并在最终10条中区分三个相关部分。[1][2] 原文说明实际施测的是德文；作者英文条目可供查阅，不表示本网站英文、中文译文或网站显示规则已经完成相应验证。
paragraphs.en: Blötner (2026) developed and investigated the PPS in two German samples, distinguishing three related parts in the final ten items.[1][2] The paper specifies that German was administered. Availability of author-provided English does not establish validation of this website’s English, Chinese translation or display rules.

paragraphs.zh: 原研究也讨论样本构成、假设情境与真实行为的差距，以及跨文化推广等限制。[1] 因此，本页不引用原研究来承诺本站准确率、不套用国外常模，也不把三部分当作全球通用诊断分类。判断本站测量质量仍需实际语言、人群、题本和用途的证据。
paragraphs.en: The study discusses sample composition, differences between hypothetical tasks and real behaviour, and cross-cultural generalisation limits.[1] It therefore supplies no accuracy guarantee, imported norms or universal diagnostic categories for this site. Evaluating this website requires evidence for its actual languages, users, form and uses.

title.zh: 善意、职责与选择空间：先回到具体事情
title.en: Kindness, duties and available choices: start with the situation

paragraphs.zh: 回看一次答应时，分开记录四件事：别人提出什么、已有约定是什么、自己有哪些需要、现实中有哪些可行选择。例如照顾家人时暂时调整计划，可以是有意承担；要另外看是否有接替、资源和休息安排，而不是只问“我拒绝了吗”。
paragraphs.en: For one agreement, separate the request, existing commitments, your needs and the choices actually available. Temporarily changing plans to care for family can be an intentional responsibility. Consider backup, resources and rest arrangements rather than asking only whether you refused.

paragraphs.zh: 经济依赖、照顾责任、组织权力或安全顾虑可能影响表达空间，分数不会消除这些条件。建议中的对话只适用于自愿、普通、可安全讨论的情境；不要求立即对抗、停止必要照顾，或通过重大工作与关系决定来证明边界。
paragraphs.en: Financial dependence, care duties, workplace power or safety concerns can constrain expression; a score does not remove them. The conversation examples apply only to voluntary, ordinary situations where discussion is safe. They do not require immediate confrontation, withdrawal of essential care or major work and relationship decisions to prove a boundary.

title.zh: 自身需要：把抽象不适改成具体安排
title.en: Own needs: turn a vague difficulty into an arrangement

paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，可以选择一次低风险、非紧急请求，先在心里补齐“我现在需要……”。例如“我需要先把已经答应的任务完成，今天只能帮你核对第一页”。这既表达可提供的帮助，也说明自己的限制；不需要先证明对方不合理。[5]
paragraphs.en: If you wish, choose a low-stakes, nonurgent request and first name what you need. For example: “I need to finish the task I already agreed to. Today I can check only the first page.” This states available help and your limit without needing to prove that the request was unreasonable.[5]

paragraphs.zh: 观察一次表达后，原任务和个人需要是否都更清楚，并保留一个不符合“我总忽略自己”的反例。如果没有安全或合适的机会，只记录也可以。这个小观察是本站原创练习，不是经本量表验证的治疗方案，也不以均分降低作为成功标准。
paragraphs.en: Notice whether the task and your needs became clearer, and keep a counterexample to a belief that you always neglect yourself. Simply recording an example is enough when discussion is unsuitable or unsafe. This is an original optional reflection, not a treatment validated by the scale or an exercise judged successful by a lower mean.

title.zh: 照顾责任：区分关心、职责与全部结果
title.en: Felt responsibility: separate care, duties and outcomes

paragraphs.zh: 可以问“我负责的具体行动是什么，哪些部分需要共同承担”。例如“我愿意陪你整理申请材料，但是否录取由评审决定；今晚我可以投入半小时”。关心对方不等于能够控制对方全部感受或最终结果，也不取消已经承担的必要职责。
paragraphs.en: Ask which specific action is yours and which parts need shared responsibility. For example: “I can help organise the application, but the decision belongs to the reviewers. I can give half an hour tonight.” Caring does not give control over every feeling or outcome, nor does it cancel essential duties already accepted.

paragraphs.zh: 若责任感认同较高而搁置自身需要较低，可以先看是否已经有明确分工和支持；不要因为一个分数给健康照顾贴负面标签。若感到安排超出余量，可以先讨论任务、时间和接替资源，保持对真实照顾需要的关注。[4][5]
paragraphs.en: If responsibility is strongly endorsed while setting aside needs is less endorsed, first consider whether roles and support are already clear. Do not label workable care negatively because of one score. When arrangements exceed capacity, discuss tasks, timing and backup while keeping actual care needs in view.[4][5]

title.zh: 他人期望：先澄清请求，再作回应
title.en: Others’ expectations: clarify a request before responding

paragraphs.zh: 在适合协商的场景，可以先问交付内容、截止时间和可调整部分，再回答。例如“你需要今天完成全部，还是先确认方案？我可以先做后一项”。这把对期望的猜测变成具体信息，不要求你为了显得坚定而一律拒绝。
paragraphs.en: Where negotiation is appropriate, clarify the deliverable, deadline and flexible parts before answering. For example: “Do you need everything finished today, or a plan confirmed first? I can do the latter.” This replaces guessed expectations with information, without requiring refusal as a performance of assertiveness.

paragraphs.zh: 也可以把立即答应改成一个明确的回复时间：“我核对一下已有安排，下午三点前答复你。”之后按承诺回应。观察的是是否多了一次真实选择，不是别人是否永远满意，更不把对方的失望自动归为你的失败。[5]
paragraphs.en: You might replace an immediate agreement with a clear reply time: “I’ll check my existing commitments and reply by three.” Then follow through. The observation is whether you gained a real choice, not whether everyone remained satisfied or whether another person’s disappointment means you failed.[5]

title.zh: 重测、混合情境与何时需要更多支持
title.en: Retakes, mixed contexts and seeking further support

paragraphs.zh: 重测时先看具体条目和有效题数，记录自己想到的是哪些关系或场景。一次主要想到工作、另一次想到亲密关系，可能使回答不同；从NA变成评分也会改变均分。本站没有建立个人变化的可靠阈值，不用小数变化断定人格改变或干预有效。
paragraphs.en: For a retake, inspect item responses and rated-item counts and note which relationships or situations you considered. Thinking mainly of work once and close relationships another time can change responses; moving from NA to a rating also affects a mean. This site has no established threshold for reliable individual change, so decimal shifts do not prove personality change or intervention benefit.

paragraphs.zh: 如果相关困扰持续影响生活，可以向合格专业人员说明具体经历、影响和想获得的帮助，而不是只提供一个标签或分数。[4] 这份测试可以整理谈话问题，但不评估症状严重程度、关系是否安全、病因或治疗需要。
paragraphs.en: If these difficulties persistently affect daily life, you can describe the experiences, their effects and the help you want to a qualified professional, rather than offering only a label or score.[4] This reflection can organise questions for discussion but does not assess symptom severity, relationship safety, causes or treatment needs.

title.zh: 条目来源、CC BY 4.0许可与改编说明
title.en: Item source, CC BY 4.0 licence and identified adaptations

paragraphs.zh: 条目署名：Christian Blötner（2026），Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples，DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2，最终10条见出版方Table 1。[1][2] 本站按CC BY 4.0使用，保留作者英文并提供来源与许可链接；该许可要求适当署名并标明改动。[3]
paragraphs.en: Item credit: Christian Blötner (2026), Valuing others over oneself: development and validation of a people pleasing scale in two German samples, DOI 10.1007/s12144-026-09519-2, final ten items in publisher Table 1.[1][2] Used under CC BY 4.0 with author-provided English, source and licence links. The licence requires appropriate attribution and identification of changes.[3]

paragraphs.zh: 费马独立提供中文工作译文、中间选项标签、NA、每部分最低三条有效的显示规则、一位小数均分与原创解释。它们属于本网站改编，不声称原作者背书。原始研究与本网站版本的证据分开陈述，不把授权使用等同于中文验证、官方认证或诊断许可。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind independently provides the working Chinese translation, intermediate labels, NA, the three-rating minimum display rule, one-decimal means and original explanations. These are website adaptations, without claimed author endorsement. Permission to use the material is distinguished from Chinese validation, official certification or diagnostic authority.

title.zh: 免费完整结果与自愿保存
title.en: Full free results and optional saving

paragraphs.zh: 全部10条、三项均分或资料不足，以及三份完整解释均免费，无需注册、邮箱、付款或前置测试。点击开始直接进入题目，保存草稿不是条件。每题选1—5或NA都算完成选择；即使三部分都资料不足，也能结束并阅读全部指南，不会要求付费补全。
paragraphs.en: All ten items, three means or insufficient states and three full guides are free, with no signup, email, payment or prerequisite test. Start opens the questions directly; saving a draft is not a condition. Any 1–5 or NA selection completes an item. Even three insufficient parts finish with every guide available, without a paid completion step.

paragraphs.zh: 答案在浏览器内计分，不随计分请求上传，也不写入网址或分析事件。主动保存才留本标签页24小时草稿，完成、重测或清除即删除。分享仅为公开测试入口，不含答案、均分或私人关系资料；网站可能按Cookie设置记录不含答案的使用事件，存储或复制受限仍可完成。
paragraphs.en: Answers are scored in the browser, without upload for scoring or inclusion in URLs or analytics events. Opting in keeps a 24-hour draft in this tab, deleted on completion, retake or clearing. Sharing uses the public entry without answers, means or private relationship information. Answer-free usage events may follow Cookie settings; blocked storage or copying does not prevent completion.

question.zh: 什么是讨好型人格？这份测试测什么？
question.en: What does people pleasing mean in this test?

answer.zh: 本页沿用常见测试名称，讨论日常自报倾向：搁置自身需要、照顾他人的责任感和迎合他人的期望。10条PPS陈述分别形成三个读数，不把一个分数变成固定人格、善良等级或关系结论。
answer.en: The familiar test name refers to everyday self-reported patterns: setting aside own needs, felt responsibility for others and orientation to their expectations. Ten PPS statements produce three separate readings, not a fixed personality, kindness ranking or relationship verdict.

question.zh: PPS条目来自哪里，使用什么许可？
question.en: Where do the PPS items come from, and what is the licence?

answer.zh: 来自Christian Blötner（2026）发表的PPS最终10条，出版方Table 1提供英德条目。[1][2] 本站按CC BY 4.0保留作者英文与署名，由费马独立提供中文工作译文和已标明的网站改编；原作者并未因此背书本站。[3]
answer.en: They are the final ten PPS items published by Christian Blötner (2026), with English and German wording in Table 1.[1][2] This site retains author-provided English and attribution under CC BY 4.0, with FermatMind’s working Chinese translation and identified website adaptations, without implied author endorsement.[3]

question.zh: 这份中文版是否已完成科学验证？
question.en: Has this Chinese edition been validated?

answer.zh: 尚未。原研究实际施测德文；本网站英文、中文译文、NA、最低条数与结果解释没有相应本地验证证据。原研究的量表证据与本站改编必须分开，不直接套用原样本常模或承诺准确率。[1]
answer.en: No local validation has been established. The original studies administered German; this website’s English, Chinese translation, NA, minimum counts and interpretations lack corresponding local validation. Original scale evidence and website adaptations must be distinguished, without importing norms or an accuracy promise.[1]

question.en: How are the three means calculated?

answer.zh: 每条按1—5正向计分，本版没有反向题。自身需要四题至少三条有效；责任感、他人期望各三题都须有效。原始和除以有效条数，保留一位小数，例如2、4、5、NA在自身需要部分为11÷3≈3.7。三个部分不合成总分。
answer.en: Each item is coded 1–5 without reverse scoring. Own needs requires three of four ratings; responsibility and expectations each require all three. Divide the numeric sum by the rated-item count and round to one decimal: 2, 4, 5, NA in own needs gives 11/3≈3.7. Parts are not combined into a total.

question.zh: NA与中间选项有什么区别，资料不足能看结果吗？
question.en: How does NA differ from the middle option, and can I still read results?

answer.zh: 3分表示有些符合；NA表示无法判断或不愿回答，不补成零或中间值。全部10条完成选择后，资料不足部分不生成个人均分，但全部三份完整指南都保留，即使所有题都选NA也能结束。
answer.en: A rating of 3 means applies somewhat; NA means unsure or unwilling to answer and is not zero or a midpoint. After all ten selections, insufficient parts have no personal mean, but all three full guides remain available, including after an all-NA attempt.

question.zh: 能分成四种人格或显示我超过多少人吗？
question.en: Does it assign four personality types or a population rank?

answer.zh: 不提供。这份网站版本没有建立可用的本地常模或诊断阈值，不划四分位等级，不按最高均分派主类型，也不生成百分位、匹配概率或善良分数。小数差异也不能证明统计显著。
answer.en: No. This website edition has no established local norms or diagnostic cutoff. It produces no quartile tiers, highest-mean type, population percentile, match probability or kindness score. Decimal differences do not establish statistical significance.

question.zh: 喜欢照顾别人、责任感强一定是讨好吗？
question.en: Does wanting to care or feeling responsible automatically mean people pleasing?

answer.zh: 不能只凭这一部分判断。责任题包括照顾愿望和对他人福祉的责任感，可能涉及真实职责或自愿选择。还需看自身需要、资源、分工和表达空间；不应为了降低分数停止必要照顾。
answer.en: Not from that part alone. Its items include a wish to care and responsibility for well-being, which can reflect real duties or freely chosen care. Consider own needs, resources, shared roles and room to express preferences. Lowering a score is no reason to stop essential care.

question.zh: 讨好倾向是否等于创伤反应、焦虑或人格障碍？
question.en: Does people pleasing establish trauma, anxiety or a personality disorder?

answer.zh: 本测试没有评估这些问题，不能由回答倒推出病因或诊断。一次答应可能出于多种原因；若持续困扰影响生活，可以把具体经历和影响带给合格专业人员讨论，而不是用标签替代评估。[4]
answer.en: This test does not assess those questions and cannot infer a cause or diagnosis from responses. An agreement can have several explanations. If persistent difficulties affect daily life, discuss concrete experiences and effects with a qualified professional rather than substituting a label for assessment.[4]

question.zh: 能用PPS给伴侣或同事打分，或者换算MBTI吗？
question.en: Can I rate a partner or colleague, or convert PPS into MBTI?

answer.zh: 不能按本版这样使用。这是本人自报条目，没有建立他评或跨测评换算规则。PPS、依恋、沟通方式与人格特质的题目和解释不同；也不能用相似结果预测关系匹配、分手概率或职业适配。
answer.en: This form does not support those uses. Its items are self-report, without established observer-rating or cross-test conversion rules. PPS, attachment, communication and personality measures differ in items and interpretation. Similar results also do not predict compatibility, breakup probability or career fit.

question.zh: 做完后可以怎样使用结果？
question.en: How can I use the result?

answer.zh: 先选一段真实经历，分别写请求、职责、自己的需要与可行选择。在可安全协商的普通场景，尝试澄清任务或约定回复时间，再观察表达是否更清楚。无需立刻对抗，也不以分数降低作为唯一目标；下方有原创对话与反例。
answer.en: Choose one real situation and separate the request, duties, your needs and available choices. In an ordinary situation where negotiation is safe, clarify a task or agree on a reply time, then notice whether expression became clearer. No immediate confrontation or score-reduction target is required; guides include original dialogue and counterexamples.

question.zh: 讨好型人格测试多久，完整结果免费吗？
question.en: How long does the People Pleaser Test take, and are full results free?

answer.zh: 共10条，约4分钟，不限时。题目、三项读数和三份完整指南均免费，无需注册、邮箱、付款或另一测评。点击开始直接进入题目，保存草稿另行自愿选择，不必先勾选同意保存。
answer.en: There are ten items, taking about four minutes without a time limit. All items, three readings and three full guides are free without signup, email, payment or another assessment. Start opens questions directly; saving a draft is a separate optional choice, without an agreement-to-save prerequisite.

question.zh: 答案会上传吗？保存和分享包含什么？
question.en: Are answers uploaded, and what do saving and sharing contain?

answer.zh: 在浏览器计分，不为计分上传或写入网址、分析事件。主动保存的草稿在本标签页24小时内可恢复，完成、重测或清除即删除。分享只含公开入口，不含答案、均分或私人关系信息；不含答案的使用事件依Cookie设置处理。
answer.en: Scoring happens in the browser without uploading answers for scoring or placing them in URLs or analytics events. An optional tab draft can be restored within 24 hours and is deleted on completion, retake or clearing. Sharing contains the public entry, not answers, means or relationship details. Answer-free usage events follow Cookie settings.
